objectives.description: Use Hausa greetings, expressions of courtesy, and formulaic exchanges in everyday conversations
Perform oral drills to master correct Hausa sounds, tones, and pronunciation patterns
Carry out simple dialogues and role plays on familiar topics in Hausa
Identify and recite Hausa proverbs, kirari (praise epithets), and explain their meanings
Listen to and retell Hausa folktales, riddles, and oral narratives with comprehension
Identify letters, vowels, consonants, and tonal marks of the Hausa orthography and write them correctly
Construct simple, compound, and complex sentences in Hausa using correct grammar and syntax
Identify and use Hausa parts of speech (nouns, pronouns, verbs, adjectives) in sentences
Express time, numbers, days of the week, and months in Hausa correctly
Apply tonal marks and diacritical symbols specific to Hausa writing conventions
Read simple Hausa texts aloud with correct pronunciation, fluency, and expression
Identify main ideas and supporting details in Hausa reading passages
Write simple compositions, descriptions, and narratives in Hausa using appropriate vocabulary
Build Hausa vocabulary on familiar topics including home, school, community, and the environment
Write letters, messages, and short notes in Hausa using appropriate register and format
Identify and interpret Hausa poems, songs, and praise poetry in Hausa
Read and analyse Hausa drama texts identifying plot, characters, and themes
Describe the cultural significance of Hausa oral traditions including kirari (praise epithets) and riddles
Appreciate the role of Hausa language in preserving Nigerian cultural identity and heritage
